business_summary: Zhejiang Zhaolong Interconnect Technology Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells data cables, special cables, and connection products. The company offers copper products, such as LAN cables, patch cords, modules, cable assembles, patch panels, and multi-pair products, as well as cabinets, and other accessories. It also offers MPO cables and accessories, optical cables, fiber patch cords, optical apparatus, and related products. In addition, the company provides industrial ethernet, fieldbus, sensor, low frequency data, marine, automotive, communication, rolling stock data, motion control, chain, servo, and robot cables. Further, it offers cable assemblies, such as machine vision, ethernet cable, M8/M12, D-sub, servo, and other assemblies. Additionally, the company provides high-temperature, micro, electrical installation cables, thin coaxial cables, and consumer electronic lines. Zhejiang Zhaolong Interconnect Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Deqing, China.
